target: docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md: acuminate (PATO_0002228) on the apex of the bearer
reason: 'sub-' is 'approximately', as in suborbicular: the existing approximate-value pattern on acuminate PATO_0002228 covers it; the apex is the bearer's apex.

target: lobed (PATO_0001979) negated
reason: elobate = without lobes, the negation of PATO_0001979 lobed, like 'unlobed'.

target: semiovate (FLOPO:0991318)
reason: A semiovate outline is already one-sided (one side nearly straight); 'obliquely' adds no separate quality. FLOPO:0991318 already has these bearers (sepal, petal).

target: spike-like (FLOPO:0991142) on raceme inflorescence (PO_0030115)
reason: spiciform = spike-like: a raceme with very short pedicels that looks like a spike. The bearer is PO_0030115 raceme inflorescence and the quality is FLOPO:0991142.

target: glandular-pubescent (FLOPO:0991173)
reason: Minutely hirsute with gland-tipped hairs falls under FLOPO:0991173 (at least some hairs gland-tipped). Hair length and stiffness are too fine a distinction for a separate class at 11 statements.

target: docs/odp/10-ratio-to-another-part.md with docs/odp/07-alternatives.md (as long as or longer than sepal PO_0009031)
reason: This is an equality and a comparison with a named second part, given as alternatives. Patterns 10 and 09 cover it under the union of pattern 07.

target: new: coloured marking (punctate PATO_0001512 + colour of the dots brown PATO_0000952)
reason: A compound of a marking pattern (minutely dotted, PATO_0001512) and the colour of the marks. Saying 'brown' of the whole leaf would be wrong, and a term for each colour would multiply terms. FLOPO:0991174 gland-dotted is not used because glands are not stated.

target: spine-tipped (FLOPO:0991210)
reason: pungent-pointed = ending in a stiff, sharp point, the meaning of FLOPO:0991210 spine-tipped (a child of PATO_0002258 pointed). The bearers (leaflets, bracts) match that class.

target: sheathing (FLOPO:0991105)
reason: vaginiform = sheath-shaped. Bracts and outer leaves reduced to sheaths round the axis are FLOPO:0991105 sheathing.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (decreased width towards perigynium PO_0009044)
reason: A comparison with its second part named (perigynium PO_0009044) is pattern 09. Bare 'narrower' was rejected only because the second part was missing.

target: new: present part with a quality of its own (awn PO_0025349 present on the bearer + awn decreased length PATO_0000574)
reason: aristate is already the rule 'awn present' (C207). 'short' is a quality of the awn, not of the sepal or leaf, so it needs the awn as the bearer of decreased length, not a new value.

target: comparison or relation stated without its second term
reason: A comparative colour like 'paler' and 'darker', which the previous review rejected. Where the second surface is given ('above than below'), pattern 09 applies to the full statement, not to this word.

target: new: coloured marking (spotted PATO_0000333 + colour of the spots white PATO_0000323)
reason: maculate = spotted (PATO_0000333). The colour belongs to the spots, not the bearer. This is the same compound as brown-punctulate and should go through one pattern.

target: grooved (PATO_0002255)
reason: A misspelling of canaliculate, which rule C194 maps to PATO_0002255 grooved. 'subcaniculate' takes the approximate-value pattern.

target: docs/odp/02-bounded-measurement.md on the throat of the corolla (needs a throat bearer; PO has none) + width
reason: A measurement of a region of the corolla, not a quality word. The missing piece is a bearer for the corolla throat (none in po_lexicon), not a value.

target: new: conjunction of two values (truncated PATO_0000936 and brush-like shape PATO_0002315)
reason: Style-branch appendages that are truncate and crowned with a brush of hairs have two qualities at once. Both exist in PATO (penicillate already maps to PATO_0002315 by rule C229). This is not a continuum.

target: docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md: blue (PATO_0000318)
reason: 'tinged' means faintly suffused with a colour, a hedged colour value like 'bluish'. The approximate-value qualifier on PATO_0000318 keeps it out of OWL as a firm 'blue'.

target: docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md (stem PO_0009047 count 1 per whole plant)
reason: A count of main stems (1), the opposite of FLOPO:0991366 multistemmed. The count pattern states it without a new value.

label: acrid
definition: A flavourful quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having a sharp, burning or irritating taste.
reason: A real taste quality used for diagnosis (e.g. latex and stems of Euphorbiaceae). PATO has bitter but no acrid, and FLOPO:0991340 sour sits under the same parent PATO:0001329. Sweet-tasting in the same statements needs its own rule.

target: loose (PATO_0001802)
reason: 'sheath baggy to tight fitting' = loosely enveloping the stem, the sense of PATO_0001802 loose. The bearer is the sheath; 'spine: baggy sheathed' is a transcription that puts it on the wrong bearer.

target: transcription fragment
reason: A fragment of 'mid green' or 'mid brown' split off a colour continuum ('mid to dark green'). It means nothing alone; the colour range belongs to the continuum pattern on the full phrase.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (perpendicular to PATO_0002434 towards the rachis)
reason: A relational PATO quality (PATO_0002434) with its second part named is pattern 09. 'rachis' needs the frond or leaf it belongs to as context.

target: anastomosing (FLOPO:0991128)
reason: Veins that rejoin to form a network is the definition of FLOPO:0991128 anastomosing; 'reticulate' only restates the network. Every example is negated ('not anastomosing-reticulate'), so the statements take the negation form on this value.

target: new: coloured marking (streaked FLOPO:0991206 + colour of the lines red PATO_0000322)
reason: Marked with fine lines (FLOPO:0991206 streaked) whose colour is red: the same colour-of-marks compound as brown-punctulate and white-maculate. 'or not' and 'not' are alternatives and negation on that.

target: new: conjunction of two values (spike-like FLOPO:0991142 and flowers in clusters, FLOPO:0991098 fascicled)
reason: A spike-like inflorescence whose flowers are clustered in glomerules: two existing values together, not a third. 'interruptedly' (gaps between clusters) also makes it a candidate for FLOPO:0991189 distant on the clusters.

target: generic part: it needs the organ it belongs to
reason: Not a quality but a measurement of an unnamed 'projection'. The examples mix spore ornament, bracteole outgrowths and a plain tepal length, so the grouping is a transcription artefact.

target: new: quality of a named part of the bearer (vascular bundle PO_0005020 part of petal + violet PATO_0001424)
reason: The colour is the veins' colour, not the petal's. The annotation has a vein of the petal as bearer and violet as quality, with 'darker' and 'light to deep' as qualifiers or a continuum.

target: subacute (sensu botany) (FLOPO:0991096)
reason: 'broadly' only widens the angle of a subacute apex; the value is FLOPO:0991096, which is defined for apices.

target: new: conjunction of two values (glandular PATO_0002117 and scabrous FLOPO:0991058)
reason: Rough and glandular at once. Both values exist, and at 10 statements a combined class like glandular-pubescent is not warranted.

target: distant (FLOPO:0991189)
reason: 'flowers well separated along the axis' = widely separated from the nearest structures of their kind, the definition of FLOPO:0991189. With a named second part ('from the ...') it is pattern 09 with PATO_0001505 separated from.
